glen_cathedral_guide.text: Welcome to Glendalough, Gleann Dá Loch, the valley of the two lakes. St Kevin settled here in the 6th century and the monastery flourished for six hundred years.
Most of the stones you see here date from about the 10th to the 12th century. They have seen a lot of weather.
Kevin liked the quiet. Today you can still hear it. The ducks help.
